name: 242. Passthrough media bodies parsed into the dedicated log fields (passthrough parsed logs)
description: Non-text passthrough routes are parsed into the same dedicated log fields a typed request fills, through the logging plugin's shared captureRequestInput / applyContentOutputToEntry helpers. OpenAI: /v1/embeddings fills embedding_input and embedding_output, /v1/audio/speech fills speech_input (the audio response stays a binary placeholder), and /v1/images/generations fills image_generation_input and image_generation_output. Gemini (/genai_passthrough/v1beta): :embedContent and :batchEmbedContents fill embedding_input and embedding_output (one entry per input), and Imagen :predict fills image_generation_input and image_generation_output. Vertex (/genai_passthrough/v1/projects/.../locations/...): an embedding model on :predict (text-embedding-005) fills embedding_input and embedding_output from the instances/predictions shape, and Imagen :predict fills image_generation_input and image_generation_output. Parsing is best-effort and runs only when content logging stores content. Each case polls /api/logs/<x-bifrost-request-id> until params.parsed_type appears. Red before the change: parsed_type never appears and the dedicated fields stay empty.

item.name: 242.1 openai/text-embedding-3-small /openai_passthrough/v1/embeddings logs parsed embedding input and output (passthrough parsed logs)

exec: pm.test('openai embeddings parsed: upstream call succeeded', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.eql(200); });
var reqId = pm.response.headers.get('x-bifrost-request-id');
pm.test('openai embeddings parsed: x-bifrost-request-id echoed', function () { pm.expect(reqId, 'x-bifrost-request-id header').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
function checkLog(attempt) {
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + '/api/logs/' + reqId, method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) {
var j = (!err && res.code === 200) ? res.json() : null;
if (j && j.params && j.params.parsed_type !== undefined) {
pm.test('openai embeddings parsed: parsed as embedding', function () { pm.expect(j.params.parsed_type, JSON.stringify(j.params)).to.eql('embedding'); });

pm.test('openai embeddings parsed: stored as embedding and tagged passthrough', function () { pm.expect(j.object, JSON.stringify(j)).to.eql('embedding'); pm.expect(j.is_passthrough, JSON.stringify(j)).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('openai embeddings parsed: embedding_input recorded', function () { pm.expect(j.embedding_input, JSON.stringify(j)).to.be.an('array').with.lengthOf(1); });
pm.test('openai embeddings parsed: embedding_output recorded', function () { pm.expect(j.embedding_output, JSON.stringify(j)).to.be.an('array').with.lengthOf(1); });
pm.test('openai embeddings parsed: raw request body kept', function () { pm.expect(j.passthrough_request_body, JSON.stringify(j)).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('openai embeddings parsed: raw response body kept', function () { pm.expect(j.passthrough_response_body, JSON.stringify(j)).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

pm.test('openai embeddings parsed: passthrough params intact', function () { pm.expect(j.params.status_code, JSON.stringify(j.params)).to.eql(200); pm.expect(j.params.path, JSON.stringify(j.params)).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
return;
if (attempt < 10) { setTimeout(function () { checkLog(attempt + 1); }, 1000); return; }

pm.test('openai embeddings parsed: log row carries parsed passthrough fields', function () { pm.expect.fail('log ' + reqId + ' has no params.parsed_type after 10 reads: ' + (err ? String(err) : (res.code + ' ' + res.text()))); });
checkLog(0);
